de1.P4.C4.ghi_chu: Anh cho san 15 m (image17) x 6 m (image14), dien tich loi di 46 m^2 (image16). Cac phuong an y a deu dua tren san 10 x 6, va phuong an B ((x + 10)(x + 6) - 60) khai trien ra dung x^2 + 16x, trung voi phuong an D, nen trac nghiem co 2 dap an dung. Mau y b ghi x = 1 cung khong thoa phuong trinh nao: voi 46 m^2 thi x^2 + 16x = 46 cho x xap xi 2,49; voi loi di hinh chu L doc 2 canh san 15 x 6 thi 21x - x^2 = 46 cho x xap xi 2,48. Can thay doi chieu hinh goc truoc khi sua.
